askLabel: Name for this chat (only you see it)
askLead: Someone shared this contact link. Write who you are and why you are writing: they choose whether to answer.
askPrivate: Nothing is sent until you tap Send. You learn who they are only if they accept.
askedOff: This contact link was turned off. Your request was not delivered.
askedSeen: Your request arrived. They answer if they want to; if they accept, this chat starts.
askedSending: Request sent. They see your name and message, and answer if they want to. You learn who they are only if they accept.
busy: Too many requests are waiting: new ones are not read until you answer some.
empty: No requests waiting. People who open your contact link and write to you show up here.
linkHint: One link to put on a site or a card. It names nobody: whoever opens it can send you a request, and you choose whom to talk to.
linkNotPublished: The link could not be published yet. It is tried again while you are online.
linkPrivate: The link shows nothing about you: no name, no key. Your name reaches someone only when you accept their request.
linkWords: contact, public link, site, website, requests
missed: {{count}} more people tried to reach you while too many requests were waiting.
noLink: You have no contact link. Make one in Settings to let people write to you.
title: Requests
unverified: Names are what each person typed: nobody checked them. Accept starts a chat; Decline sends nothing back.
